title: Enterprise Integrations

body.text: At the enterprise level, Claude connects into your ecosystem several ways:
direct API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and MCP to connect internal tools
— choose based on your existing infrastructure. A team already on AWS that uses Bedrock passes compliance more easily.

example: "A bank uses Claude via Bedrock because its data is already in the AWS VPC, so it doesn't leave the audited environment"
